clips.title: The story
paras: Riverpaw gnolls under Hogger threaten travelers at Forest's Edge, along Elwynn's southwestern frontier.

At Forest's Edge, woodland runs southwest from Stormwind City between Mirror Lake Orchard and the rivers that border Westfall. Westbrook Garrison lies nearby, but Stormwind's thin ranks leave the woods open to wild beasts and raiding parties. Boars roam among the trees and along the banks. Riverpaw gnolls gather here in force, using the woods as a staging ground.

Hogger and his pack hunt through the woods of Forest's Edge. A massive, brutal gnoll chieftain, he leads raids on nearby farms and harasses travelers. The Stormwind Army has placed a bounty on his head. His pack makes the timberland dangerous for anyone who crosses it.
